Ruby & Sapphire

Released July 1, 2003 · 109 cards

Ruby & Sapphire is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on July 1, 2003. It has 109 cards. It includes 87 Pokémon, 13 Trainer and 9 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

20 illustrators worked on Ruby & Sapphire. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (31), Atsuko Nishida (10), Mitsuhiro Arita (10), Hajime Kusajima (8), Kagemaru Himeno (7), Midori Harada (7), Kouki Saitou (5), Hikaru Koike (3).
